findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: calligraphy_compile_board · Private data: calligraphy_preflight_audit, calligraphy_compile_board, calligraphy_verify_stablecoin_payment, calligraphy_create_coinbase_checkout, calligraphy_purge_job_vault, calligraphy_route_pcb · Public sink: calligraphy_verify_stablecoin_payment, calligraphy_request_ip_whitelist.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: calligraphy_compile_board · Private data: calligraphy_preflight_audit, calligraphy_compile_board, calligraphy_verify_stablecoin_payment, calligraphy_create_coinbase_checkout, calligraphy_purge_job_vault, calligraphy_route_pcb · Public sink: calligraphy_verify_stablecoin_payment, calligraphy_request_ip_whitelist

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
